sentences.text: Heard Mr. K. N. Choudhury, learned senior counsel assisted by Mr. M. Ahmed, learned counsel appearing for the writ petitioner in both these writ petitions.

Also heard Mr. B. Gogoi,
learned Standing Counsel, Health Department, Assam appearing for the official respondents, who submits that these matters are ready for disposal and can be taken up for final disposal.

Mr. Gogoi,
however, prays for posting these matters again on a non-miscellaneous day.
On the request of learned counsel for both the sides, these writ petitions are directed to be listed again on 03.04.2025 as fixed items.
An attempt would be made to dispose of the writ petitions at the admission stage.
Interim order passed earlier to continue till the next date fixed.
